scripts.//-- dev --: Local dev servers: frontend on 7777, backend on 3001 (docs/STACK.md). The backend reads a local synthetic CHIRPS copy, MAP grid and DEM from backend/.local/ (gitignored): run `dev:data:synthetic` once first (docs/run-locally.md § Backend data).
scripts.//-- dev: sign-in --: Opt-in local services for sign-in (docs/run-locally.md § Sign-in): DynamoDB Local on 127.0.0.1:8000 and Mailpit (SMTP 1025, UI http://localhost:8025), from docker-compose.yml. `pnpm dev` needs neither: by default the user list is in memory with admin@example.test as the dev admin, and codes print to the backend terminal. `dev:auth:seed` makes the table and the dev admin in DynamoDB Local.
scripts.//-- build --: Build every workspace that has a build script (packages/* are consumed as TypeScript source and have none).
scripts.//-- check --: Typecheck and repo guards. `check` typechecks every workspace (--no-bail: one failure does not hide the rest); `check:<surface>` one. `check:env` = the committed .env.development files stay local-only (local hosts, reserved mail domains, dev-only- keys, local data sources; never prints a value; CI job env-isolation; docs/security.md § Secrets management).
scripts.//-- test --: vitest. `test` runs every workspace (--no-bail); `test:<surface>` runs one. Engine tests use synthetic fixtures only. `test:coverage` = the same tests with v8 coverage, then a table of what no test reaches (a report, never a gate; HTML in each workspace's coverage/). `test:frontend:e2e` = Playwright against the built site (needs `pnpm --filter @pitman/frontend exec playwright install chromium` once). `test:scripts` = the root-scripts guard (every target here resolves; this block keeps its //-- groups; scripts/ci-guards/root-scripts.mjs). `test:tools` = `test:scripts`, then the node:test suites for the repo scripts under scripts/ and infra/scripts/ (coverage summary, CSP check, CloudFront functions) and the guards in scripts/ci-guards/ (workflows, pre-commit, these guards' own tests); CI's `test` job runs it.
scripts.test:tools: pnpm test:scripts && node --test scripts/coverage-report/*.test.mjs scripts/ci-guards/*.test.mjs infra/scripts/*.test.mjs
scripts.//-- admin --: Operator actions on the production user table, run by hand with the operator's AWS profile (AWS_PROFILE, default pitman); each reads the address from stdin, never argv, and is audited. The table and code key are read from the Lambda's environment. docs/deployment.md § Sign-in; erasure: docs/security.md § Erasure.
scripts.//-- workspaces --: Run any script in one workspace: `pnpm frontend <script>`, `pnpm wrsm <script>`; `pnpm wrsm-cli wrsm run <dir>` runs the CLI under tsx.
